gloss_en: "You are a priest" (atah khohen) — the scriptural phrase from Psalms 110:4 ("You are a priest forever after the order of Melchizedek"), addressed to Abraham/the priestly archetype, invoked in Likutey Moharan I:54 as the aspect of the kohen linked to love ("Abraham My lover") and to the priest's kemitzah ("and the priest shall scoop")
